XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Cars equipped with Start&Stop system

  • System: Electronics

  • Device: Starter motor micro-relay

  • Fault: When the vehicle is stationary, the engine switches off normally with Start&Stop but does not restart automatically, requiring manual starting with the key.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P0512 (Starter motor - Incorrect command)

  • Cause: Faulty starter motor micro-relay

• Action: Check that the starter motor micro-relay is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the faulty relay, which controls the Start&Stop system and the starter motor, is located in the fuse box on the driver's side of the engine compartment, in position 10 (starter motor micro-relay).
    After its replacement, no adjustment was necessary using diagnostic equipment and the component did not show any anomalies upon visual inspection.
